newsitem.title: FRANCE: Mali ready to join Zaire relief force.
newsitem.headline: Mali ready to join Zaire relief force.

text.p: The West African state of Mali said on Friday it was ready to join a proposed international force to open aid corridors for refugees in eastern Zaire.
Mali has close ties with former colonial power France which has taken the lead in trying to create such a force. Only Spain has so far indicated readiness to contribute toops.

"Mali is ready to contribute to the creation of a humanitarian force under the auspices of the Organisation of African Unity and the United Nations whose mission would be to safeguard and protect thousands of African lives now under threat," the government said in a statement released in Paris.
The statement did not say how many soldiers Mali could send.
French officials have spoken of a need for about 5,000 troops, one third Europeans, one third Africans and one third Americans.
